Still guessing when your frying oil is actually ready?

Getting crispy homemade fried food can be surprisingly frustrating when you're using an ordinary pot. Too cool and food can come out heavy and oily. Too hot and you risk overcooking the outside before the inside is ready.

The Ellis® 2.2L Deep Frying Pot was designed to give you more control over the entire process.

The built-in thermometer lets you monitor your oil temperature while you cook, while the deep-sided design creates a more purpose-built setup for stovetop frying. Once your food is ready, simply place it on the integrated draining rack and let excess oil drip conveniently back into the pot.

Use it for homemade french fries, crispy chicken, tempura shrimp, vegetables, onion rings, and all the fried favorites you normally save for restaurants.

No bulky countertop deep fryer. No constantly guessing your oil temperature. Just a smarter way to fry at home.

Heat it. Fry it. Drain it. Enjoy it.
